description: Synthetic 6-group inhour check: hand-built params plus the stable period.
provenance: Params are hand-picked round numbers (NOT a data-library evaluation). stable_period_s is the unique positive root of rho = Lambda*w + sum beta_i*w/(w + lambda_i) at rho=0.002, found by Newton iteration in float64 (residual 0.0); the 1e-10 residual gate re-verifies it inside the crate.
